# Pocketgull RSNA Knee ConvNeXt-Large Model

## Model Overview
This model repository contains pre-trained multi-label abnormality classification weights trained on de-identified 3D knee MRI scans as part of Pocketgull's clinical decision intelligence pipeline.

## Architecture & Training
- **Backbone**: ConvNeXt-Large (FP16 ONNX export support)
- **Loss Function**: Asymmetric Loss (ASL) with gamma_minus=4.0, gamma_plus=1.0
- **Validation Protocol**: 5-Fold GroupKFold anchored by patient_id

## HIPAA & Safe Harbor Compliance
All data and model inputs comply strictly with HIPAA §164.514(b)(2) Safe Harbor de-identification rules.
